skill.name: koyobun-check
skill.description: 文化審議会建議「公用文作成の考え方」(令和4年)に基づき、日本語の公的文書・社内文書の表記を校閲する。公用文、通知文、お知らせ文、漢字の開き、送り仮名、数字や符号の使い方のチェックに対応。創作・私的な文章の添削や翻訳は対象外。
skill.summary: Review Japanese administrative and business writing using a checklist based on the 2022 Council for Cultural Affairs recommendation.
skill.author: tahodev

content.user_title: Review Japanese Official and Business Documents
content.value_statement: Japanese administrative documents require consistent notation and rules suited to their audience. This skill applies a structured checklist and explains corrections using recommendation sections.
actual_capabilities: Classifies documents by purpose and audience to adjust proofreading strictness.
Checks kanji, hiragana substitutions, okurigana, and loanword notation.
Reviews numerals, digit grouping, punctuation, brackets, and heading hierarchy.
Checks administrative terminology, sentence clarity, and style consistency.
Pairs corrections with recommendation sections and distinguishes required fixes from optional improvements.
Uses a built-in checklist without requiring network access.
limitations: Creative writing, translation, and statutory drafting are outside the stated scope.
The checklist reflects the 2022 recommendation and does not automatically detect later changes.
Uncertain kanji readings and issues outside the checklist require additional authoritative reference checks.
The referenced shared response-contract document is not included in the supplied single-file skill.

use_cases.title: Review Administrative Notices
use_cases.description: Check notices for notation rules and explain required corrections with recommendation sections.

use_cases.title: Standardize Internal Documents
use_cases.description: Review internal announcements for consistent numerals, terminology, punctuation, and sentence style.

use_cases.title: Improve Public Explanations
use_cases.description: Adapt public information text to its audience while separating rule violations from optional readability improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Short Notice
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Japanese notice for residents: [text]. Identify corrections and cite the relevant checklist sections.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a short notice

prompt_templates.title: Check Notation Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this internal announcement: [text]. Check kanji, okurigana, loanwords, numerals, and punctuation. Separate required fixes from optional improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Review Public Information
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this public information article for [audience]: [text]. Apply the explanatory document category. Suggest clearer wording without changing factual meaning.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Full Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this [document type] for [audience]: [text]. Group findings by section. Include original wording, correction, rule reference, and priority. Flag uncertainty and state the reference date.

output_examples.input: A resident notice contains: 申請書を提出して下さい。
output: Required correction: 申請書を提出してください。
The auxiliary expression ください should be written in hiragana.

output_examples.input: A horizontal internal report states: 参加者は5000人でした。
output: Required correction: 参加者は5,000人でした。
Numbers with four or more digits use commas every three digits.

output_examples.input: A public information draft uses both サーバ and サーバー.
output: Suggested standardized notation: サーバー.
Use the final long-vowel mark and keep notation consistent throughout the document.

best_practices: Specify the document category and intended audience before requesting a review.
Request rule references and separate required corrections from optional readability suggestions.
Verify uncertain points and newer standards against authoritative sources before final publication.
anti_patterns: Apply administrative notation rules mechanically to poetry, fiction, or advertising copy.
Treat proofreading suggestions as approval of statutory drafting or legal validity.
Accept unsupported rule claims or assume the built-in checklist includes every later policy update.

faq.question: Which standard does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses a checklist based on the Council for Cultural Affairs recommendation issued on January 7, 2022.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: No. The built-in checklist works without network access. Official links are references for separate verification.

faq.question: Can it review internal business documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers practical business writing as well as administrative notices and public information documents.

faq.question: Why does the document category matter?
faq.answer: Notices require stricter notation. Public explanations allow more reader-focused choices, including hiragana and reading aids.

faq.question: Can it translate text or draft legislation?
faq.answer: No. Translation, creative writing, and statutory drafting are outside its stated scope.

faq.question: How does it handle uncertain rules?
faq.answer: It asks about unclear audiences, marks issues outside the checklist, and defers uncertain kanji judgments pending authoritative verification.
